title: ICS pointing model
description: A station mount's pointing model, fitted to stars by python/ics_models/pointing (ICS-035) and loaded by the C++ encoder module (ICS-036). The line of sight is sky = encoder + sum(value_rad * basis(name, encoder)), with each term's basis as python/ics_models/pointing/model.py defines it and golden/pointing pins it. Angles are in radians: azimuth from north through east, elevation up from the horizon. See schemas/README.md.

model_id.description: The model's own name, unique per station, for example the station and the night's date.

station_id.description: The station, as named in the range configuration.

created_utc.description: When the model was fitted, ISO 8601 in UTC.

site.description: Where the station is: geodetic WGS84 latitude and longitude, east positive, and height above the ellipsoid.

terms.description: The model's terms, in the order they were fitted; each name at most once.

sigma_rad.description: Its standard deviation from the fit, in radians.

fit.description: How the fit went. C17 is held_out_rms_urad: the on-sky RMS on stars the fit never saw.

observations_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the observation file the model was fitted to.
